Superdrug Exclusive Own Brands
Superdrug manufactures and distributes several popular in-house labels that are vegan, cruelty-free, and budget-friendly:
Superdrug
Studio London:
Makeup and beauty accessories
B.:
Vegan skincare, cosmetics, and men's grooming ranges
Me+:
Ingredient-focused skincare with acids and boosters
Naturally Radiant:
Brightening and fruit-extract plant-based skincare
Solait:
Suncare, tanning, and travel essentials
Vitamin E & Optimum:
Hydration and targeted anti-ageing skincare lines
Layering Lab & Artiscent:
Fragrances and body mists

Major Popular Third-Party Brands
The retailer stocks leading multinational manufacturers and high-street names across cosmetics, hair, and skincare, including:
Skincare & Body:
CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, Nivea, Aveeno, Dove, Vaseline, and Bioderma
Haircare:
Batiste, Aussie, Charles Worthington, and Bleach London
Makeup & Eyes:
Maybelline, Rimmel, Barry M, and Eylure
